decision_maker: Codex acting under delegated research-design instruction
authority_excerpt: Generate multiple possible mechanisms and approaches. Compare multiple implementations of the underlying abstraction and choose the strongest testable version.
rationale: Bounded predictor bank has a finite auditable implementation and directly tests the v1 recurrence failure. Learned-rule meta-training adds unbounded architecture and meta-data choices unsupported by an original charter.
novelty_boundary: Expert reuse and gradient skipping are established; this is a narrow empirical study, not a claimed foundational invention.
